authority.registry.applications.approve_: This registers the operator of application {id}, valid until {until}, issues its number and a secret part, and e-mails the applicant. The secret part is shown nowhere else.
This registers the operator of application {id} for the configured period, issues its number and a secret part, and e-mails the applicant. The secret part is shown nowhere else.

authority.registry.applications.refuse_b: This refuses application {id}. The reason is e-mailed to the applicant as you write it.
